parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

😎
blood[blʌd]n.
Blood is the red liquid in your body.
→ I cut my finger and got blood on my shirt.
😎
burn[bə:rn]v.
To burn something is to set it on fire.
→ I burned some wood in the camp fire.
😎
cell[sel]n.
A cell is a small room where a person is locked in.
→ The jail cell was very small.
😎
contain[kəntein]v.
To contain something is to have it inside.
→ The mailbox contained a letter.
😎
correct[kərekt]adj.
To be correct is to be right.
→ All of my answers on the test were correct.
😎
crop[krap]n.
A crop is food that a farmer grows.
→ Wheat is a crop that is made into bread.
😎
demand[dimænd]v.
To demand something is to say strongly that you want it.
→ The workers demanded to be paid more money.
😎
equal[i:kwəl]adj.
To be equal is to be the same.
→ Both students are equal in age.
😎
feed[fi:d]v.
To feed is to give food.
→ Mother feeds my baby brother everyday.
😎
hole[houl]n.
A hole is an opening in something.
→ The man was going to jump into the hole in the ice.
😎
increase[inkri:s]v.
To increase something is to make it larger or more.
→ They've increased the price of gas by 15 cents!
😎
lord[lo:rd]n.
Long ago, a lord was a man in charge of a town.
→ The lord of the town was not kind.
😎
owe[ou]v.
To owe is to have to pay or give back something received from another.
→ I owed him twenty dollars, so I paid him back.
😎
position[pəziʃən]n.
A position is the way something is placed.
→ How can you sit in that position?
😎
raise[reiz]v.
To raise something is to lift it up.
→ We had to work together to raise the last piece.
😎
responsible[rispansəbəl]adj.
If a person is responsible, they do the right things.
→ I try to be responsible and save money.
😎
sight[sait]n.
A sight is something interesting to see.
→ I saw the pyramids of Egypt. What a sight!
😎
spot[spat]n.
A spot is a place where something happens.
→ The kitchen is a good spot to eat meals.
😎
structure[strʌktʃər]n.
A structure is a building.
→ They just built a beautiful new structure downtown.
😎
whole[houl]adj.
Whole means all of something.
→ I ate the whole pie. We don't have any more.

sections.title: Exercise 2: Fill in the blanks with the correct words.

questions.content: I left my coat in the __________ by the window.
questions.explanation: Từ phù hợp nhất để điền vào chỗ trống là spot (chỗ, vị trí).

questions.content: The poor man had no money to __________ his family.
questions.explanation: Từ phù hợp nhất là feed (nuôi ăn).

questions.content: The robber was locked in a __________ for a year.
questions.explanation: Từ phù hợp nhất là cell (phòng giam).

questions.content: Did you read the __________ book or just part of it?
questions.explanation: Từ phù hợp nhất là whole (toàn bộ).

questions.content: If I get the answers __________, I will pass the test.
questions.explanation: Từ phù hợp nhất là correct (đúng).

questions.content: What did your father demand?
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi: Bố bạn đã yêu cầu điều gì? Trả lời: Rằng tôi phải dọn phòng.

questions.content: Will you help me raise this?
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi: Bạn sẽ giúp tôi nâng cái này lên chứ? Trả lời: Được. Cao bao nhiêu?

questions.content: What position were these in?
options: They were next to each other.
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi: Những cái này ở vị trí nào? Trả lời: Chúng ở cạnh nhau.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi: Cái chai đó có chứa nước không? Trả lời: Không, nó chứa sữa.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi: Bạn có nghe tin nhà Jim bị cháy không? Trả lời: Thật khủng khiếp!

sections.title: Exercise 4: Choose the word that is a better fit for each sentence.

questions.content: The bad guy sat on the floor of his __________.
questions.explanation: Kẻ xấu ngồi trên sàn phòng giam của hắn (cell).

questions.content: Dad says the old __________ is not safe.
questions.explanation: Bố nói cấu trúc/tòa nhà cũ kỹ (structure) này không an toàn.

questions.content: The __________ ruled over 100 people in the town.
questions.explanation: Lãnh chúa (lord) cai trị hơn 100 người trong thị trấn.

questions.content: I still __________ the bank money for my university loan.
questions.explanation: Tôi vẫn còn nợ (owe) ngân hàng tiền vay học đại học.

questions.content: Won't your legs hurt if you stay in that __________ for long?
questions.explanation: Chân bạn sẽ không đau nếu bạn ở tư thế (position) đó lâu chứ?

questions.content: This is our favorite picnic __________.
questions.explanation: Đây là địa điểm (spot) dã ngoại yêu thích của chúng tôi.

questions.content: The __________ class was excited.
questions.explanation: Cả lớp (whole class) đều hào hứng.

questions.content: I dug a __________ to put a tree in.
questions.explanation: Tôi đã đào một cái lỗ (hole) để trồng cây.

questions.content: Do not __________ any of the animals at the zoo.
questions.explanation: Đừng cho bất kỳ con vật nào ở sở thú ăn (feed).

questions.content: The farmer grew a __________ of potatoes.
questions.explanation: Người nông dân trồng một vụ (crop) khoai tây.

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
The Farmer and the Cats

Arthur was a responsible farmer, and Maria was a nice lady. But they were poor. They owed the town lord money for their land. One summer, their farm burned. One structure caught fire, and most of the animals ran away. Only the cats stayed. So Arthur and Maria had to bring in their crops without an animal's help.

On a fall day, the lord demanded his money. Arthur asked if the lord could wait until he brought in his crops.

The lord was angry. He raised his hands high and yelled, "Pay me by the end of the week. If you don't, I will increase the money you have to pay. I might put you in a jail cell."

So Arthur and Maria worked until there was blood on their hands. They finished four lines of corn and went to bed.

But the next morning, eight lines were finished! "Maria, didn't we stop in this spot here?" Arthur asked.

"Yes, that is correct. And the tools were in a different position, too," Maria said. They were surprised and happy. That day, they worked hard and finished five lines.

But in the morning, ten lines were done! Each day they did a lot of work. Each night, someone else did an equal amount of work. In a week, the whole field was finished. "Tomorrow I will sell the crops and pay the lord," Arthur said. But that morning, the crops were gone. A bag was in the middle of the field. It contained money.

"Maria, let's see who has helped us work." Through a hole in the wall, they saw a funny sight. The cats were dancing in the field and eating corn! Now Arthur knew what had happened. The cats had worked at night! After that, Arthur was very nice to his cats and fed them lots of corn.

questions.content: What does Arthur do in the story?
options: Put the lady in a jail cell
Work until there is blood on his hands
questions.explanation: Trong truyện, Arthur làm việc chăm chỉ cho đến khi tay rớm máu (Work until there is blood on his hands).

questions.content: What is true of the cats in the story?
options: They burn the farm and scare the animals.
They do work equal to Arthur's work.
They think Arthur is very responsible.
They put all the tools in one spot.
questions.explanation: Mỗi đêm mèo làm một lượng công việc bằng với công việc của Arthur (They do work equal to Arthur's work).

questions.content: What does the bag contain?
questions.explanation: Trong truyện có đoạn nói túi đó chứa tiền. Ở đây đáp án đúng là Money for the lord.

questions.content: What sight did Maria and Arthur see in the morning?
options: A hole in the wall of their house
A whole new structure on the farm
The lord working in their fields
The cats dancing on the farm
questions.explanation: Sáng hôm đó họ nhìn thấy qua lỗ hổng trên tường những con mèo đang nhảy múa trên cánh đồng (The cats dancing on the farm).

questions.content: When will the lord increase the money that Arthur has to pay?
options: If he doesn't pay by the end of the week
If he doesn't bring in his crops
If he doesn't put the lady in a cell
If he doesn't find the cats
questions.explanation: Lãnh chúa sẽ tăng tiền nếu Arthur không trả vào cuối tuần (If you don't [pay me by the end of the week], I will increase the money you have to pay).

sections.title: Reading Comprehension (The First Peacock): Answer the questions.

questions.content: What is this story about?
options: Why it is essential to guard cows
How the image of a peacock in the sky came about
How being born with 100 eyes benefited a man
questions.explanation: Câu này đúng vì phù hợp với ngữ cảnh của bài.

questions.content: Why was guarding Hera's cow easy for Argos?
options: All it did was eat grass all day.
It was kept separate from all the other cows.
He had a chance to listen to music.
He was able to sleep instead of focusing on it.
questions.explanation: Câu này đúng vì phù hợp với ngữ cảnh của bài.

questions.content: Why did Zeus turn Argos into a group of stars?
options: He wanted Argos to see the site of his trouble.
He was certain that Argos would fall asleep.
He wanted to make Argos remain in the sky forever.
He wanted to cause Argos immediate trouble.
questions.explanation: Câu này đúng vì phù hợp với ngữ cảnh của bài.

questions.content: What was the primary function of Argos' job?
options: To make sure the cow was never sad
To keep the cow far away from people
To see the effects of music on the cow
Work for a proud goddess named Hera
questions.explanation: Câu này đúng vì phù hợp với ngữ cảnh của bài.

questions.content: How did Argos sleep?
questions.explanation: Câu này đúng vì phù hợp với ngữ cảnh của bài.
questions.correctAnswer: He only rested a few eyes at a time. The others stayed awake.
